class.name: Overworld
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] The root node of overworld scenes that manages player placement, camera integration, and BGM fade-in.
class.description:
[b]Overworld[/b] is the root node that manages the overworld state of the project. It initializes the player and camera by finding the actual nodes through their NodePaths, sets the entry direction and coordinates using the map entrance [RoomEntranceNode] information, and fades in the BGM for playback.
[b]Required Settings:[/b] • player_path and camera_path must be set • PlayerOverworld and CameraController nodes must exist
[b]Example (GDScript):[/b] [codeblock] extends Overworld @onready var tres := preload("res://encounters/tres/sans.tres")
func ready() -> void: print("Overworld ready() called") var tb := stagehand.summontextbox() tb.generic(Dialogues.new().from(["* Do you want to fight?", "* You can fight later."]), ["Yes","No"]) tb.connect("selected_option", func(i:int): if i == 0: scene_changer.load_battle(tres) ) await tb.dialogue_finished global.set_player_can_move(true) [/codeblock]
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: ready
method.description: A function that can be used instead of [method Node._ready], but unlike regular _ready(), it is automatically called every time the overworld is loaded. Override to implement overworld-specific initialization logic.

method.name: start_cellphone
method.description: Called when a phone call is started from the [UI]. The [param id] parameter represents an index in the [member Global.cells] array. You can perform actions such as displaying a text box with [method Stagehand.summontextbox].

method.name: player_died
method.description: Called when the player dies. This function can return a list of dialogue lines to play during the player's death sequence as a [PackedStringArray].

method.name: start_music_fade_in
method.description: Starts playing background music with a fade-in effect. Only plays new music if it's different from the currently playing music or when returning from battle. Automatically called upon initialization completion.

method.name: toggle_encounter
method.description: Toggles the overworld battle mode. If battle mode is disabled, it activates it; if activated, it disables it and removes all bullets.

method.name: add_bullet
method.description: Adds a bullet to the overworld. Instantiates the bullet scene and adds it as a child, connecting it to the remove_bullets signal. The root node of the bullet scene must be a Bullet class and have a fade() method. Used in overworld battle mode.

method.name: quick_bullet
method.description: Adds a bullet to the overworld and immediately sets its position, rotation, and scale. Internally calls add_bullet() to create the bullet, then sets the specified position (pos), rotation angle (rot_deg), and scale (scale). Used in overworld battle mode.

members.member: The camera controller node found through camera_path. Used as read-only in scripts.
Path to the camera controller (CameraController). This is a required setting; if empty, initialization will be aborted.
Background music resource. If not set, the default overworld BGM will be loaded.
The background music player (same as [method Global.get_Music]). Used as read-only in scripts.
The player node found through player_path. Used as read-only in scripts.
Path to the overworld player node (PlayerOverworld). This is a required setting; if empty, initialization will be aborted.
Array of RoomEntranceNodes placed in this map. Used to determine the player's starting position and direction when moving between maps.
The name of the current overworld. Used for save file display or debugging purposes.

signal.name: cached_initialized
signal.description: Emitted when the overworld is reloaded after a battle ends, or when [method SceneChanger.load_cached_scene] is called.

signal.name: remove_bullets
signal.description: Signal to remove all bullets. Emitted when all bullets in the overworld need to be removed. Also emitted when battle mode is disabled by [method toggle_encounter].

signal.name: room_initialized
signal.description: Emitted when the room is initialized. Passes a dictionary containing data used for room initialization as a parameter.
